task.visible_issue: Better error checking in ScriptEventHadler; setting up script event handler when configured script directory/path is broken/not existing results in HTTP 500

source_hypothesis: Property ScriptEventHandler.actions calls os.listdir(script_directory) without any OSError handling. The original /event/actions/Script HTTP route calls h_obj.actions directly. Missing directory causes FileNotFoundError and a 500 unless caught upstream. Graceful empty available-actions dictionary with warning in this property is a plausible local behavior, not a proven complete HTTP API fix.
